faq.question: What services does The Web Yard offer?
faq.answer: We build business websites, custom web applications, Shopify stores, Streamlit applications and dashboards. We also offer AI automation, SEO improvements, and website maintenance.

faq.question: Who do you work with?
faq.answer: We work with businesses and individuals across Pakistan who need a professional website, e-commerce store, custom web application, or other digital solution.

faq.question: How do I get a quote for my project?
faq.answer: You can contact us on WhatsApp and tell us about your project. After understanding your requirements, we will discuss the scope and provide a custom quote.

faq.question: How long does a project usually take?
faq.answer: The timeline depends on the type and complexity of the project. Smaller websites can take less time, while custom web applications and larger systems may require a longer development process.

faq.question: Do you offer support after a website is launched?
faq.answer: Yes. We can provide website maintenance, updates, bug fixes, and other support based on your project's requirements.
